01 — Profile

About me

I'm a Cybersecurity Engineer currently based in Singapore, working across offensive security, SOC operations, and client advisory at an enterprise scale.

My day-to-day spans penetration testing engagements, vulnerability assessments, SIEM rule engineering, and delivering remediation roadmaps to clients. Outside of work, I grind HTB machines, build writeups, and prep for offensive security certs.

Current focus: OSCP / OSCP+ certification path, AD exploitation chains, and deepening tradecraft across the full kill chain.
